input.summary: Fix illusory cap basis: all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement, greater of 12 months' amounts or USD 1,000,000
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap is tied to "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory. We have changed the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and Order Forms in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000; the Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) remain outside the cap.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000

input.summary: Delete the 15%-per-week liquidated damages payable by Customer for late payment
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer; a 15% of annual Fees per-week charge is punitive and unbounded, so we have deleted it. If Vendor needs a late-payment remedy, we can accept simple interest at a commercially reasonable rate on undisputed overdue amounts.
